THE_ARCHITECT.talk.BIDEN.0-0r.ancient: So the dozing one has climbed my Spire.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.BIDEN.0-1r.char:
Folks, here's the deal. I took the stairs. All of them.
No joke. Now... where was I?
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.BIDEN.0-2r.ancient: Then wake up, and face me.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.BIDEN.1-1r.char:
Look, I wasn't asleep. I was resting my eyes.
[i][font_size=22]The aviators come on. They begin to glow.[/font_size][/i]
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.BIDEN.1-2r.ancient: At last, a stare worth answering.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.BIDEN.2-0r.ancient: Every climb, the same long story.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.BIDEN.2-1r.char:
C'mon, man. You built a whole Spire to hear
how the story ends? Fine. It ends with lasers.
NEOW.talk.BIDEN.0-1.char:
I'm up, I'm up! Just resting my eyes.
Here's the deal, big fella: what've you got?
DARV.talk.BIDEN.0-0.ancient: Well look at you! Sharp shades, pal. Can you even see my pile?
DARV.talk.BIDEN.0-1.char:
See it? Friend, I've got a story about a pile just like this one.
There was this ice cream stand, see, and—
DARV.talk.BIDEN.0-2.ancient: Hah! Take somethin' before the story gets to the sprinkles!
DARV.talk.BIDEN.1-0r.ancient: Back again? No stories this time, just pick somethin'!
OROBAS.talk.BIDEN.0-0.ancient: Sleepy man! Shades man!! Awake? Asleep? Which??
OROBAS.talk.BIDEN.0-1.char: [i][font_size=22]Sleepy Joe explains trains to Orobas for a very long time.[/font_size][/i]
OROBAS.talk.BIDEN.0-2.ancient: Choo choo!! Choo choo!! Take take!!!
OROBAS.talk.BIDEN.1-0r.ancient: Train man is back!! More choo choo!! Look look!
PAEL.talk.BIDEN.0-0.char:
Big dragon! Hey, pal, you look tired.
I know a thing or two about that. Catch a nap.
PAEL.talk.BIDEN.0-1.ancient: [thinky_dots]Take a part of me... and let me... rest...[/thinky_dots]
PAEL.talk.BIDEN.1-0r.char:
Still melting, friend? C'mon, man.
I'll take a little piece. Get some sleep.
TANX.talk.BIDEN.0-1.char:
These? Oh, that's just the aviators, pal.
Or maybe it's Dark Brandon. Hard to say.
TANX.talk.BIDEN.0-2.ancient: GLOWING EYES!! NOW GO FIGHT SOMETHING!!!
TANX.talk.BIDEN.1-0r.ancient: THE GLOWING ONE RETURNS!! MORE WEAPONS FOR THE GLOWING ONE!!
TEZCATARA.talk.BIDEN.0-0.ancient: Oh my, a [jitter][b]sleepy[/b][/jitter] visitor! Who might you be, sweetie?
TEZCATARA.talk.BIDEN.0-1.char:
Name's Joe. Folks call me Sleepy Joe. Not a joke.
You got any ice cream around here? Chocolate chip?
TEZCATARA.talk.BIDEN.1-0r.ancient: Welcome back, sweetie! Still so very... [jitter][b]drowsy[/b][/jitter].
NONUPEIPE.talk.BIDEN.0-0.char:
Hello, friend. Here's the deal: I'm here for
the blessing, and maybe a quick nap.
NONUPEIPE.talk.BIDEN.0-1.ancient:
A drowsy traveller! Your stories are long, your shades are... dark.
Come closer, receive my blessing.
NONUPEIPE.talk.BIDEN.1-0r.ancient: Back again? Receive my blessing, and perhaps... stay awake this time.
VAKUU.talk.BIDEN.0-0.ancient: A drowsing mortal? Within these accursed walls?
VAKUU.talk.BIDEN.0-1.char:
Drowsing? Me? C'mon, man. I'm wide awake.
[i][font_size=22]A snore escapes.[/font_size][/i]
VAKUU.talk.BIDEN.0-2.ancient: Then let us deal, sleeper. Try to stay awake for it.
VAKUU.talk.BIDEN.1-0r.ancient: Back to haggle with a demon? Bold. Let us see what you'll trade.
